definitions.explanation: A feeling of great pleasure and satisfaction.

examples.japanese: {合格|ごうかく}の{喜|よろこ}びを{分|わ}かち{合|あ}った。
examples.english: We shared the joy of passing the exam.
examples.notes: 喜びを分かち合う = to share joy

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}の{成長|せいちょう}を{見|み}るのは{喜|よろこ}びだ。
examples.english: Watching my child grow is a joy.

examples.japanese: {喜|よろこ}びの{涙|なみだ}を{流|なが}した。
examples.notes: 喜びの涙 = tears of joy

notes:
USAGE: {喜|よろこ}び is the noun form of the verb {喜|よろこ}ぶ (to be happy). It expresses positive emotions like joy and delight.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{喜|よろこ}びを{感|かん}じる (to feel joy)
・{喜|よろこ}びを{分|わ}かち{合|あ}う (to share joy)
・{喜|よろこ}びの{声|こえ} (cries of joy)
・{喜|よろこ}びの{涙|なみだ} (tears of joy)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{楽|たの}しみ - enjoyment, pleasure
・{幸|しあわ}せ - happiness
・{歓喜|かんき} - great joy (formal)
